clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Carendin Halgar trains Forsaken warlocks in the dark arts. Sharp-tongued and impatient, he teaches them to bind demons from the Twisting Nether, including Voidwalkers and Succubi.

Carendin Halgar trains warlocks in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. He demands focus and obedience, with little patience for failure, hesitation, or weakness. His students move beyond simple incantations to summon demons and manipulate souls. Under his direction, they learn the Forsaken way of making demons serve.
